name: Myopia
source:
Connor loves apocalyptic stories, especially if it has monsters in them. He never expected he'd be in one though. Especially one where he'd slowly become one too.

[From [url=https://vyeriosaki.itch.io/myopia]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
康纳喜欢世界末日故事，尤其是里面有怪物的故事。但他没想到自己会成为其中一员。尤其是他也慢慢成为其中之一。

[来自[url=https://vyeriosaki.itch.io/myopia]Itch.io[/url]]
